authority: Analytics Engine → API / production dataset contract → Power BI
authoring_rule: Power BI must not calculate an alternative version of any of the 49 semantic metrics. Visuals bind to already-authorized API payloads.
source: Trusted export via the existing API. Live Supabase remains QUARANTINED; activating it later must not require rebuilding these pages.

refresh.mode: API import or DirectQuery against the production dataset contract, not against Postgres/SQL
refresh.cadence: On demand or scheduled refresh of cached API payloads. Evidence is an immutable export until a later live bind.
must_not: client-side DAX substitutes for engine metrics

pages.visual_rule: KPI cards only where headline_permitted is true. BLOCK/SHOW_BOTH tiles use conflict or multi-definition visuals. No profit headline card.
Bind display_name, trust_level, value only if headline_permitted. Tenant dues and profit use /api/metrics/{id}/conflict.
Occupancy is SHOW_BOTH: multi-definition table, never a single occupancy % card.
DISCLOSE caveats render beside the number. NOT_DETERMINABLE renders the exact unavailable sentence, never zero.
Attention queue from engine insights. No invented materiality colours.
Every competing definition labelled. Never a winner. Role filtering from /api/roles/{role_id}/workspace only.

role_visibility.rule: Power BI must not hardcode role permissions. Authorization is the existing API role policy.
